title: Correlation
text: Cross-correlation of two inputs, 2 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Rounding mode} sets Method of rounding operation; {Computation domain} sets the domain in which the block computes the cross-correlation, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Product output}, {Accumulator}, {Output}, {Output Minimum} sets the minimum value block can output, {Output Maximum} sets the maximum value the block can output and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: First data input signal vector | matrix | N -D array

ports.name: Port_2
ports.summary: Second data input signal vector | matrix | N -D array

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Cross-correlated output vector | matrix | N -D array

params.name: Computation domain
params.values: Domain in which the block computes the cross-correlation Time (default) | Frequency | Fastest

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Method of rounding operation Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on

params.name: Product output
params.values: Product output data type Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: Accumulator data type Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Output
params.values: Output data type Inherit: Same as accumulator (default) | Inherit: Same as input | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Output Minimum
params.values: Minimum value block can output [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output Maximum
params.values: Maximum value the block can output [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
